info.description: Stripe-paid contract over a library-catalog (1 ContractDefinition). Persistent; supports lazy negotiation per asset.

consumerId.description: Buyer userId sent as payment_intent.metadata.consumerId for replay protection in the connector.

providerUrl.description: EDC provider base URL copied from the catalog at checkout time

consumerUrl.description: Buyer's own consumer connector URL (Management API base). Set once after payment and reused for every consume of this purchase.

consumerApiKey.description: X-Api-Key for the buyer's consumer connector.

policyId.description: EDC contract policy id of the catalog at checkout time

contract_agreements.description: Map { assetId: contractAgreementId } populated lazily on first consume of each asset
